quote: SPO05 was announced in July 2025 and represents an investment of R$300 million. SPO06 is scheduled to be inaugurated in May 2027, with an estimated investment of R$600 million. Together, the two data centers will deliver a total capacity of 26 MW.
note: Opened Ascenty English campus page 2026-10-04; growth-revenue page corroborates R$300m SPO05 within USD 1bn 2026 LatAm CapEx envelope.
